categories.name: AI & ML Security
categories.summary: OWASP released the highly anticipated GenAI Data Security Best Practices v2, providing a comprehensive twelve-part implementation playbook for organizations building AI security programs. The document covers AI-DSPM program development, operational KPIs, and phased rollout strategies, marking a significant maturation in enterprise GenAI security guidance.

key_items.title: OWASP GenAI Data Security Best Practices v2 Released
key_items.detail: Part 1 of a twelve-part playbook establishing GenAI data-security fundamentals, six core principles, and detailed guidance for building AI-DSPM programs with 90/180/365-day rollout sequencing.

key_items.title: NCSC Guidance on Agentic AI Defense
key_items.detail: UK's National Cyber Security Centre published guidance on defending against agentic AI systems, highlighting emerging challenges in AI-driven threat landscapes.

categories.name: Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities & Analysis
categories.summary: Microsoft published a data-driven analysis of commonly exploited vulnerabilities in real-world attacks, providing actionable intelligence for defenders. Japan's AI Safety Institute also released evaluation notes on GLM-5.3's implications for vulnerability management practices.

key_items.title: Microsoft Analysis of Exploited Vulnerabilities
key_items.detail: Data-driven research examining common vulnerabilities exploited in real-world attacks, offering defenders insights into prioritization strategies.

key_items.title: GLM-5.3 Evaluation Impact on Vulnerability Management
key_items.detail: Japan's AI Safety Institute analyzes what the GLM-5.3 evaluation results mean for vulnerability management workflows and AI-assisted security tooling.

categories.name: Threat Intelligence
categories.summary: Kaspersky's Securelist reported on CyberStrikeAI attacks, documenting AI-enhanced threat campaigns. A notable social engineering incident revealed how a job-seeking employee inadvertently enabled a major crypto hack through a malicious test assignment download.

key_items.title: CyberStrikeAI Attack Campaign Documented
key_items.detail: Kaspersky researchers detail a new attack campaign leveraging AI capabilities for enhanced threat operations.

key_items.title: Crypto Hack via Job Interview Social Engineering
key_items.detail: Major cryptocurrency breach traced to an employee downloading a malicious 'test assignment' while job hunting, highlighting persistent social engineering risks.

categories.name: AI Research & Models
categories.summary: New AI model releases included Hydrogen-1.0 on Hugging Face from deep-principle, and the craft-anything project appeared on GitHub for creative AI applications. These releases continue the rapid pace of open-source AI development.

key_items.title: Hydrogen-1.0 Model Released
key_items.detail: Deep-principle released Hydrogen-1.0 on Hugging Face, adding to the growing ecosystem of open AI models.

key_items.title: Craft-Anything Project
key_items.detail: New GitHub project 'craft-anything' released by storytold for creative AI generation applications.

categories.name: Industry News & Policy
categories.summary: The OECD published comprehensive guidance on enhancing user control and privacy protections in AI contexts, signaling continued regulatory focus on AI governance. A blog post highlighted how AI-related factors contributed to PostgreSQL 19's delayed release.

key_items.title: OECD AI Privacy Protection Guidelines
key_items.detail: New OECD report provides frameworks for enhancing user control and privacy protections specifically in AI deployment contexts.

key_items.title: PostgreSQL 19 Delayed Due to AI Factors
key_items.detail: Blog analysis explores how AI-related developments contributed to delays in PostgreSQL 19's release schedule.

categories.name: Miscellaneous
categories.summary: Channel discussion included commentary on industry fearmongering tactics following security incidents, and various social media shares on AI developments.

key_items.title: Commentary on Post-Incident Fearmongering
key_items.detail: Channel discussion critiquing how organizations launch fearmongering campaigns following security failures.

top_insights: Enterprise AI security is maturing rapidly with OWASP's comprehensive 12-part GenAI security playbook providing structured implementation guidance for organizations.
Social engineering remains a critical vector—the crypto hack via job interview test assignment demonstrates that human factors continue to bypass technical controls.
Regulatory bodies (OECD, NCSC, AISI Japan) are actively publishing AI-specific security and privacy guidance, indicating accelerating policy development globally.
The intersection of AI capabilities and vulnerability management is receiving increased scrutiny, with evaluations of how LLMs like GLM-5.3 impact security workflows.
AI-enhanced threat campaigns (CyberStrikeAI) are being documented by major threat intelligence firms, confirming operational use of AI by threat actors.
